'''Wisel's''' was an arms [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] shop at the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], located in [[The Life]] section of the station. Its proprietor was the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Wisel]], who however could arrange deals for heavy weaponry.
